items.text: Siem ne jo-Efraim
Mano kaka unune malit un osimbo mar jomer man Efraim,
maber mare malich biro rumo ka maua maner,
mopidhi ei holo momiyo
mana kaka josunga malwokore gi kongʼo!
Ne, Ruoth Nyasaye nigi ngʼato man kod loch gi teko.
Mana kaka pe kod yamo maketho piny,
e kaka obiro kelo koth machwe mabubni giteko
matiek gik moko duto manie lowo.
Osimbo ma jomer man Efraim sungorego
ibiro nyono gi tielo.
Berne malich norum mana ka maua maner,
mopidhi ei holo momiyo,
mi nochal ka olemb ngʼowu mokwongo chiek,
ngʼato angʼata monene pone,
kendo chame ka rikni morum chuth.
E kindeno Jehova Nyasaye Maratego nobedi kaka
osimbo mar duongʼ maber ne joge manok modongʼ.
Enobed e chuny jangʼad bura mowinjore
kendo enojiw jolwenjeu makedo,
e dhorangeyeu obed gichir kendo olochi.
To jogi bende kwangʼ
nikech divai kendo gibayo nikech kongʼo:
Jodolo kod jonabi mer makwangʼ nikech kongʼo
kendo gitagore nikech divai,
githembo ka gineno fweny,
gichwanyore ka gingʼado bura.
Mesa duto opongʼ gi ngʼok,
onge kamoro amora ma ok dungʼ tik marach.
"En ngʼa motemo puonjo?
To koso en ngʼa ma otemo yarone tiend wachne?
Ne nyithindo mogolie chak,
koso ne joma koro eka ogolie thuno?
Onyisowa weche mak winjre ka mag jomomer ni:
Tim ma, tim macha kendo tim ma, tim macha."
To kata kamano Nyasaye biro wuoyo gi jogi
gi dho welo kod dhok mayoreyore.
Mowachone niya,
"Ma en kar yweyo, joma ool mondo oywe."
Kendo niya, "Ma en kar kwe,"
to ne ok ginyal winjo.
Kuom mano, wach Jehova Nyasaye biro chalonegi mana ka wach awacha mar joma omer niya:
Tim ma, tim macha,
kendo tim ma, tim macha,
matin ka, matin kacha,
mamiyo gikwangʼ koni gi koni mi gipodhi
kendo gihinyre ma makgi e obadho.
Kuom mano winjuru
wach Jehova Nyasaye un joma jaro ji ma,
jotend ogandani modak Jerusalem.
Usungoru niya, "Wasetimo singruok gi tho
wasedonjo e winjruok gi liete omiyo,
ka masira miwachono nolandre e piny to ok nomulwa,
nimar waseketo miriambo ragengʼ-wa,
kendo wuondruok ka kar pondo."
Ma e gima Jehova Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Duto wacho,
"Ne, aketo kidi e Sayun, ma en kidi moyier,
en kidi motegno, ma nengone tek,
moriwo kor ot kendo man-gi mise mongirore;
ma ngʼat moyie kuome
ok nobam.
Abiro miyo adiera bedo tol mipimogo
kendo tim makare kaka rapim mirieyogo ot;
to kodh pe biro yweyo karu mar pondo,
un jo-miriambo kendo pi biro pongʼo kuondeu mag tony.
Singruok maru gi tho nobed maonge;
kendo winjruok mane utimo gi liete ok nobedi.
Ka masira nomwomre,
to mano ema nochwadu piny.
E kinde duto ma masira nobi enotieku;
noyweu okinyi ka okinyi kendo odiechiengʼ gotieno."
Ka wachni nodonjne ji,
to ginibed gi bwok maduongʼ.
Kitanda nobed machiek ma ok nyal rieye tielo tir,
kendo onget nobed matin ma ok nyal umo ngʼato maber.
To Jehova Nyasaye biro aa malo mana
kaka notimo e Got Perazim,
mirimbe nowuogi kaka ne otimore e Holo mar Gibeon,
mondo oti tichne, tichne mayoreyore ma ji kia
kendo timne mar wich teko.
Koro weuru ajara mondo kik tol motweugo ridre,
nimar Ruoth Nyasaye ma en Jehova Nyasaye Maratego,
osenyisa wach mar kethruok mabiro kwako piny duto.
Chik iti kendo iwinj dwonda,
keturu chunyu mondo uwinj weche mawacho.
Ka japur puro puodho mondo okom
to bende osiko ka opuro apura?
Koso bende osiko ka obuso abusa?
Kosetieko loso puothe donge ochwoyo kothe mopogore opogore
kendo okiro kal?
To donge opidho shairi kanyo kod ngano e bath puodho?
Nyasache nyise yo monego oluw
kendo puonje yo maber.
Cham moko ok din gi twor to
bende kal ok wuothie wiye gi gari;
moko to idino gi luth
kendo kal itengʼo gi kede.
Ngano nyaka regi mondo olos makati;
omiyo ok dine amingʼa.
Kata obedo ni oywayo gache mar dino kuome,
to faresene ok rege.
Magi duto bende oa kuom Jehova Nyasaye Maratego,
ma jangʼad rieko mowinjore,
kendo ma parone ber ahinya.
